mapper.select: SELECT sl.id AS slot_id, sl.schedule_id AS schedule_id, sl.organization_id AS organization_id, sl.start_time AS start_time, sl.end_time AS end_time, sl.status_code AS status_code, sl.capacity AS capacity, sl.booked_count AS booked_count, (sl.capacity - sl.booked_count) AS remaining_count, CASE sl.status_code WHEN 'free' THEN '可约' WHEN 'busy' THEN '已满' WHEN 'busy-unavailable' THEN '不可约' ELSE '未知' END AS display_status, sl.overbooked_flag AS overbooked_flag, actor.actor_id AS practitioner_id, sch.healthcare_service_id AS healthcare_service_id, prac.`name` AS practitioner_name, hs.`name` AS healthcare_service_name, org.`name` AS organization_name FROM wkf_slot sl LEFT JOIN wkf_schedule sch ON sl.schedule_id = sch.id LEFT JOIN wkf_schedule_actor actor ON sch.id = actor.schedule_id AND actor.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_practitioner prac ON actor.actor_id = prac.id AND prac.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_healthcare_service hs ON sch.healthcare_service_id = hs.id AND hs.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN adm_organization org ON sl.organization_id = org.id AND org.is_deleted = 0 WHERE sl.is_deleted = 0 AND sl.schedule_id = #{query.scheduleId} AND sl.organization_id = #{query.organizationId} AND sl.start_time >= CONCAT(#{query.date}, ' 00:00:00') AND sl.start_time <= CONCAT(#{query.date}, ' 23:59:59') ORDER BY sl.start_time ASC
